create_export_document_response: create an ExportDocumentResponse with filename and optional markdown, JSON, HTML, text, or doctags content
build_export_result: build an ExportResult container with ExportDocumentResponse, conversion status, errors, and profiling timings
build_chunked_document_result: build a ChunkedDocumentResult with a list of ChunkedDocumentResultItem chunks and document export results
create_docling_task_result: create a DoclingTaskResult wrapping a ResultType with processing time and conversion counts
create_websocket_message: create a WebsocketMessage with a MessageKind enum value and optional task status or error message
